Disconnect the VPN on the home screen before removing subscriptions.
Your VPN in one app. Add a subscription, choose a server and connect.\n\nBuilt on the open-source v2rayNG and Xray projects.
Servers are downloaded from your subscription link. Refresh your subscriptions or add another one.
The provider returned a notice instead of servers. Contact your VPN support to enable Filvless or add another subscription.
Manage subscription links and server updates
Connection rules for websites and networks
Choose which applications use the VPN
Filvless • preview 0.1\nBased on v2rayNG and Xray. Component source code and licenses are available below.
Copy the subscription link from your VPN bot and add it here. Servers will appear after the subscription downloads.
Paste a subscription link or connection configuration.
Every 6 hours when internet is available
Enter one domain per line, for example example.com. Subdomains are included. Other traffic follows your subscription rules. Saving reconnects an active VPN.
Check domain names. A domain or its subdomains cannot be in both lists. Maximum 200 entries per list.
The new version downloads in the background. Installation will be offered next time you open the app.
The update is ready to install.
Could not download or verify the update. Check your connection and free storage, then retry.
You can close this screen. Downloading continues in the background; installation will open on your next visit.
Allow Filvless to install updates. Android will still ask you to confirm each installation.
Expiry: %1$s, based on the last subscription update. Renew in the bot.
Checks the current configuration without switching servers. The report contains only app/Android versions and result codes.
Wi-Fi or mobile network is available. This alone does not confirm internet access.
No network. Enable Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
Select a server on the main screen or add a subscription.
This profile has no subscription link. A standalone configuration can still work.
The subscription endpoint responds. The server list was not changed.
The subscription endpoint denied access. Update the subscription or contact support.
Could not reach the subscription endpoint. Try another network or update the subscription later.
The subscription redirects to another address. Use Refresh on the main screen to check it with the normal importer.
The subscription endpoint reports an expired subscription. Renew it in the bot.
The saved expiry date has passed, but no current date was returned. Update the subscription before renewing.
The TCP port responds. For JSON profiles this checks one representative endpoint, not every internal server.
The tested TCP endpoint did not respond. Try another server. A JSON profile may have other working endpoints.
This profile cannot be evaluated by a simple TCP test. See the VPN check below.
VPN is off. Connect on the main screen, then repeat this check.
A control request passed through the running Xray configuration. If one app still fails, contact support.
Internet access through this connection was not confirmed. Reconnect or choose another server.
The check could not finish. Please retry.
